For people interested in old consoles and computers, aka the retro gamers, check out the Vectrex Roli channel. He's got a shitton of very good content, and some really rare and exotic old consoles.

https://www.youtube.com/user/VectrexRoli

NeoGAF (yeah, I know...) has some great threads about this very subject. Lots of information on which monitors to buy, how to get it set up, etc. - and plenty of in-game pictures showing off those beautiful scanlines and rich colors.

If I still had any of my old consoles, I'd be all over this kind of thing. Sadly, I'll have to make due with OpenEmu and the shittier picture quality it provides.

I would also argue that this isn't nearly as pointless as the author says it is. Most devs back in the day designed the graphics around the scanlines and pixels on old-school TVs. Modern emulators show off all the tricks and shortcuts they used to accomplish this, ironically making the games look uglier, breaking the immersion, and somewhat spoiling the experience in the process.
